**Comparison of the two traces**

Both traces solve the same 3-coloring problem with identical core strategy: identify B as the highest-degree node, assign Red, propagate to C (Blue), force D and E to Green, then resolve the remaining nodes A, F, G, H, I. Both arrive at functionally equivalent solutions.

The main divergence is in alternative-solution exploration. Trace 1 opens an "**Alternative Solution?**" branch with C=Green instead of C=Blue, fully derives a second valid coloring, then explicitly discards it ("Let's stick with Solution 1"). Trace 2 similarly opens a branch with "Let's check if I=2 leads to a solution," finds another valid coloring, and also discards it. Neither branch yields new constraints—the sibling trace confirms the same solution is reachable without the detour, so these are CYCLEs that pay off only by confirming multiplicity of solutions.

Both traces also suffer from extensive re-verification LOOPs. Trace 1 re-checks edges in blocks like "Wait, did I check C-I?" and re-derives the entire solution in "Let's re-run Solution 1 logic." Trace 2 is even more extreme, re-verifying all edges in "Let's check all pairs" and "Let's re-verify the constraints one last time," then descending into near-verbatim repetition with "Wait, check 'C-G' again" blocks that re-check the same four edges multiple times. The sibling trace shows these verifications add no new constraints—both solvers had already confirmed correctness.

⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="**Alternative Solution?**" end="This looks valid too." basis=Opens a branch exploring C=Green, fully derives a second valid coloring, then explicitly discards it to return to Solution 1. Grounded alternative explored and eliminated.⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Wait, did I check C-I?" end="List: F-G, F-B. No F-I." basis=Re-checks edges C-I, A-D, A-F, F-I that were already covered in the initial solution verification, adding no new information.⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Wait, I see 'H-I' in the list." end="Looks good." basis=Re-verifies the H-I edge and H-B, H-I constraints already checked in the first verification block, adding no new information.⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let's re-run Solution 1 logic" end="H(Green) - I(Red) : OK." basis=Re-derives the entire solution step-by-step following the same logic as the original derivation, adding no new constraints.⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's check if I=2 leads to a solution." end="This is also a valid solution." basis=Opens a branch exploring I=Blue instead of I=Red, fully derives a valid alternative coloring, then discards it to return to the first solution. Grounded alternative explored and eliminated.⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's check all pairs." end="Everything is correct." basis=Re-checks all 13 edge pairs that were already verified in the first "Let's verify the whole coloring" block, adding no new information.⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's re-verify the constraints one last time." end="Looks perfect." basis=Re-verifies all 13 conflict pairs a third time, repeating the same checks with no new constraints.⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Wait, check 'C-G' again." end="Wait, check 'H-I' again." basis=Re-checks the same four edges (C-G, E-I, F-G, H-I) that were already verified multiple times, adding no new information.
